concepts.gloss_en: the complete/perfect intellect (daat) — whole, mature knowledge

members.note: same referent — perfect/whole daat; here שלם is an adjective (complete), so the definite article on the adjective (השלם) is grammatical agreement, not an archetype-vs-generic noun shift. Both denote complete knowledge/intellect.

notes: Article difference is on the adjective (שלם 'complete'), not on the head noun, so rule-2 archetype concern does not apply. Referent is the same 'complete daat' in both, though attested in different Torahs (lm2:17 vs lm1:53); tiered 'likely' rather than 'obvious' due to the grammatical difference and different contexts.
